# TinyStories
**Type:** Measurement instrument  
**Supporting papers:** 11  
**Also known as:** Tiny Stories  

## State of the Field

**What it is.** Across the surveyed papers, TinyStories is most commonly described as a synthetic dataset of short, simple stories, often children's stories, generated by large language models. The prevailing framing is as a small, tractable corpus for training and evaluating small or medium-scale models, while still posing text-generation challenges such as coherence and narrative structure.

**What it is claimed to measure.** Papers link TinyStories to 2 behavioral indicators and no constructs. The prevailing use is to measure text generation, with papers using it to train or evaluate models that generate text, while a smaller line of work uses it to measure story generation through story continuation.

**Space of uses.** Most papers position TinyStories as a practical training and evaluation corpus, including uses in next-token prediction, story continuation, and generation from unseen story prefixes and suffixes; some descriptions also emphasize that its small size makes training and aggregating N-gram statistics computationally efficient. A smaller line of work uses it alongside Children Stories or ROCStories, and another use is to probe character choices as a content planning attribute.

## Sources

**TinyStories** (5 papers: [The Belief State Transformer](https://proceedings.iclr.cc/paper_files/paper/2025/file/01b3dea1871f7cea1e0e6be1f2f085bc-Paper-Conference.pdf), [Emergent Response Planning in LLMs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlresearch/v267/main/assets/dong25p/dong25p.pdf), [Linguistic Collapse: Neural Collapse in (Large) Language Models](https://proceedings.neurips.cc/paper_files/paper/2024/file/f88cc8930b47a45ec4733123bf3039b9-Paper-Conference.pdf), [On the Power of Decision Trees in Auto-Regressive Language Modeling](https://proceedings.neurips.cc/paper_files/paper/2024/file/72176f95680c3fb27a0966f36d5d0c53-Paper-Conference.pdf), [Understanding Transformers via N-Gram Statistics](https://proceedings.neurips.cc/paper_files/paper/2024/file/b1c446eebd9a317dd0e96b16908c821a-Paper-Conference.pdf))
> A dataset of synthetic short stories generated by GPT-3.5 and GPT-4, designed to be small enough for training tractable models while still presenting challenges in text generation like coherence and narrative structure.

**Tiny Stories** (1 paper: [On Understanding Attention-Based In-Context Learning for Categorical Data](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlresearch/v267/main/assets/wang25u/wang25u.pdf))
> A dataset composed of short, simple stories generated by a large language model, used for training and analyzing language generation capabilities.
